reactions: [Hacker News] Not to worry. The customer can shrug and say “rogue agents took unaligned actions”, and they too will be absolved of liability. Right?
[Hacker News] There's no paradox, there never were agents to begin with. Those are programs. It's same old software. If you sell me a software to do X and you fail to deliver, it's on you.
[Hacker News] The difference between us and agents, paradoxically, is that the agents do not have any agency.

[Hacker News] So I guess if I'm a contractor and doing a job for Meta, not only can I completely fail and they still pay me but if I do something illegal it's on them for hiring me, right?? Yeah I don't know what the solution is but something is wrong here. Maybe refund mistakes or take responsibility.

items.title: Meta says if its AI makes a mistake, it will legally be the customer's fault
